subject: Joint Enablement Roadmap: Integrator Rapid Immersion (IRI)
messages:
From: Amy Sullivan <amy@brconsulting.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Joint Enablement Roadmap: Integrator Rapid Immersion (IRI)

Hi Diego / team,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. Blue Ridge is excited to pilot a fast-track Integrator Rapid Immersion (IRI) program for our consultants so they can deliver Redwood-based solutions faster for mutual customers.

Rough ask: a 2–3 week hands-on enablement (mix of instructor-led sessions, labs, and an integration checklist) targeted at 6 consultants. We want a repeatable playbook we can run quarterly.

Can you propose a roadmap (curriculum, roles needed from Redwood, infra requirements, and a preferred schedule)? We're hoping to run the first cohort in September.

Attached: BR-Intake-Form.docx (filled).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to align logistics.

Best,
Amy Sullivan
Partner Lead, Blue Ridge Consulting
amy@brconsulting.com
+1-415-555-0182

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Amy Sullivan <amy@brconsulting.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Enablement Roadmap: Integrator Rapid Immersion (IRI)

Thanks Amy — great to see the intake form.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Program: 3-week Integrator Rapid Immersion (IRI)
  - Week 0 (self-study): basic API/SDK primers, model catalog walkthrough, security checklist
  - Week 1 (instructor-led): architecture patterns for integrations, deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
  - Week 2 (labs + capstone): hands-on lab (sample customer use case), integration checklist review, joint demo
- Roles we need: 1 solution architect (lead), 1 product trainer, 1 infra engineer (lab ops)
- Infra: dedicated sandbox project with pre-provisioned API keys, sample dataset, and 2x GPU nodes for lab bursts
- Outcomes: playbook doc, lab artifacts, a short recorded demo and an adoption checklist

I attached a draft curriculum and a checklist: IRI-curriculum-v1.pdf, integration-checklist.xlsx.

Logistics question: do you prefer compressed weekdays (three full-day sessions over two weeks) or spread-out half-days? We can support both but need to lock lab GPU windows.

If this aligns, I'll schedule a 30-min planning call with Marissa and Karthik to assign facilitators and confirm the sandbox.

Diego Fernandez
Partner Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Amy Sullivan <amy@brconsulting.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Enablement Roadmap: Integrator Rapid Immersion (IRI)

Diego / Amy — adding a few operational constraints and suggested facilitators.

Operational notes:
- Lab ops: our infra team can reserve GPU windows on Thursdays 9:00–16:00 (PST). If you need evening sessions for APAC folks, we can provision an additional node but it'll add cost.
- Headcount: we can support up to 8 consultants per cohort with two SAs running breakout rooms.
- Materials: recommend we record the architecture sessions and publish the capstone solution in the partner Git repo.

Suggested facilitators from Redwood:
- Karthik Iyer (lead trainer) — covers architecture patterns and deployment choices
- Monica Patel (labs & automation) — covers sandbox setup and lab exercises

Quick ask for Amy: can Blue Ridge confirm curriculum priority (model ops vs prompt engineering vs deployment patterns) — that will help us tune Week 1.

Date: 2026-08-03T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Joint Enablement Roadmap: Integrator Rapid Immersion (IRI)

Diego / Marissa — this looks great, thanks. Quick answers:
- Curriculum priority: model ops (40%), deployment patterns (30%), prompt engineering (30%). We want consultants to be operationally ready to support customers end-to-end.
- Preferred cadence: compressed weekdays (three full-day sessions) — avoids calendar drag for consultants.
- We can run the first cohort the week of Sept 14.

Next steps:
1) Diego: confirm facilitator availability and lock GPU windows for week of Sept 14.
2) Marissa / Monica: finalize lab playbook and share IRI-week1-agenda.pdf.
3) Amy: I'll upload a draft SOW and HubSpot deal id HS-32178 — attaching a SOW-draft.pdf for your review.

If the above looks good I'll accept Diego's invite once the 30-min planning call is on the calendar.

Thanks — Amy
